title: Roast mackerel with asparagus and new potatoes

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a traditional condiment; horseradish sauce sits alongside mustard as an ordinary cupboard jar.

supermarket.reason: New potatoes, asparagus in season, mackerel fillets, crème fraîche and horseradish are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and a bowl, and the technique is simple staged roasting.

works.reason: The staged timings at 220°C suit halved new potatoes, asparagus and skin-up mackerel fillets, and the quantities serve four sensibly.

honest_times.reason: Halving potatoes and trimming asparagus fit in 12 minutes, the sauce can be mixed while the tray roasts, and 20+8+8 matches the 36 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A late-May traybake with a generous 500g of asparagus as a main component suits the date and the weather.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish, potatoes, asparagus and salad make a balanced, appealing family dinner.
